verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API and specific endpoints such as GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with try-it or runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so a static API description is not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
